text: You meant to save this month. You really did.
But every savings app asks you to remember to deposit — and remembering is the first habit to break.
Meanwhile, every payment you make leaves a little spare change on the table.
Spare catches it. Every Nimiq Pay payment, rounded up and saved into your own stake — in one tap.
Spare runs inside Nimiq Pay. Connecting only shares your addresses — Spare can't move a single coin without your approval.
It reads the payments you've already made — even across the hidden vaults Nimiq Pay actually pays from — and rounds each one up. Here, twenty-three everyday payments left spare change behind.
Every round-up is sized to the payment, and never more than half of it. A Lightning swap that wasn't a purchase? One tap, and it's out.
One tap, one approval — and your spare change is in your own NIM stake, earning rewards. Spare never holds your money. There's no backend at all.
Want to save faster? Raise the round-up, or turn on a multiplier.
And it's real. These are two sweeps made inside Nimiq Pay on testnet — a new stake, then an add-to-stake — matching on-chain to the last luna. Open source, in English and Spanish.
Spend like you always do. Spare saves the change.
Try Spare in Nimiq Pay today.
